title: One of you is the Glitch
text: Everyone gets the same secret word on their phone, except one player: the Glitch, who only sees the category.

scene.phone:
Category: Breakfast
You don't know the word!
scene.title: ⚡ GLITCH ⚡
scene.label: The Glitch

title: Give a one-word clue
text: Write one word that proves you know the secret. Too obvious and the Glitch learns the word. Too vague and you look like the Glitch.

title: The clues go up
text: Every clue gets pinned on the big screen. Talk it over out loud. Whose clue doesn't quite fit?

title: Vote out the Glitch
text: Everyone votes on their phone. If the most votes land on the Glitch, the squad caught it.

title: One last guess
text: A caught Glitch gets one guess at the secret word. Guess it right and the Glitch steals the round anyway!

scene.phone: Which one is the secret word?

title: Scoring
text: Squad wins: everyone gets points, more if you voted for the Glitch. Glitch escapes: the Glitch scores big. Three rounds, most points wins.
